meta.label: How it is made
meta.value: Users reaching each step per release, cohort and day; helpline calls per step for STV. Built by scripts/build_data.py.

meta.label: 02_daily_funnel.sql
meta.value:
-- CSP app · Service ticket task · daily funnel by ticket-created day (IST) x cohort.
-- cohort STV     = tickets on the Service Ticket Verification release (TAS stv_mode = true, live since 6 Nov 2026)
-- cohort NON_STV = same-day tickets on the old flow (baseline)
-- Steps (48 h window from creation):
--   received -> seen by CSP -> CSP marks resolved = sent for verification (state AWAITING_VERIFICATION)
--   -> closed as resolved (stv_closure_display = RESOLVED). FAIL = reopened back to CSP.
-- Helpline = CSP inbound call (PARTNER_CALL_LOG, created_at is IST) whose Kapture ticket L2 is TICKETS or CSP APP,
--            by the same CSP between ticket creation and close (or +48 h).
with cur as (
  select execution_candidate_id eid, csp_id, stv_mode stv, state cur_state, stv_closure_display cd,
         system_verification_result svr, stv_round rnd, stv_reopened reop, coalesce(resolved_by_actor_type,'NONE') rb,
         convert_timezone('Asia/Kolkata', created_at)::timestamp_ntz ca
  from PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.RESTORE_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES
  where _fivetran_active and task_family='RESTORE' and created_at >= '2026-10-31 18:30:00 +0000'
),
hist as (
  select execution_candidate_id eid,
    min(iff(state='AWAITING_VERIFICATION', convert_timezone('Asia/Kolkata', updated_at)::timestamp_ntz, null)) av_at,
    min(iff(state='COMPLETED',             convert_timezone('Asia/Kolkata', updated_at)::timestamp_ntz, null)) done_at
  from PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.RESTORE_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES
  where task_family='RESTORE' and created_at >= '2026-10-31 18:30:00 +0000'
  group by 1
),
ct as (
  select try_parse_json(properties):execution_id::string eid, min(try_to_timestamp(timestamp)) seen_ct
  from PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CSP_API.EVENTS_DATA
  where timestamp >= '2026-11-01'
    and event_name in ('restore_candidate_opened','ticket_accepted','technician_assigned','restore_resolved')
  group by 1
),
tas as (
  select execution_candidate_id eid, min(convert_timezone('Asia/Kolkata', occurred_at)::timestamp_ntz) act_at
  from PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.RESTORE_ATTENTION_EVENT_LOG
  where not _fivetran_deleted and occurred_at >= '2026-10-31' and reason in ('TASK_ACCEPTED','TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNED')
  group by 1
),
calls as (
  select d.csp_id, p.created_at call_at
  from PROD_DB.POSTGRES_RDS_PARTNER_CALL_LOG_IVR.PARTNER_CALL_LOG p
  join (select distinct partner_id::string partner_id, csp_id from PROD_DB.DBT_CSP.DIM_CSP where etl_current) d
    on d.partner_id = p.caller:partnerId::string
  join (select ticket_no, any_value(disposition_folder_level_2) l2 from PROD_DB.DBT.STG_CX_KAPTURE_PARTNER_TICKETS_LATEST
        where is_latest and created_dt >= '2026-10-25' group by 1) k on k.ticket_no = p.kapture_ticket_id
  where not p._fivetran_deleted and p.created_at >= '2026-11-01' and k.l2 in ('TICKETS','CSP APP')
),
t as (
  select cur.*, hist.av_at, hist.done_at,
    nullif(least(coalesce(ct.seen_ct,'2100-01-01'), coalesce(tas.act_at,'2100-01-01')), '2100-01-01'::timestamp_ntz) seen_at
  from cur left join hist using(eid) left join ct using(eid) left join tas using(eid)
),
base as (
  select t.eid, any_value(t.csp_id) csp_id, any_value(t.stv) stv, any_value(t.cur_state) cur_state, any_value(t.cd) cd,
    any_value(t.rnd) rnd, any_value(t.reop) reop, any_value(t.rb) rb, any_value(t.ca) ca,
    any_value(t.av_at) av_at, any_value(t.done_at) done_at, any_value(t.seen_at) seen_at,
    count(c.call_at) help_calls, min(c.call_at) first_help_at
  from t left join calls c on c.csp_id = t.csp_id and c.call_at >= t.ca
        and c.call_at <= coalesce(t.done_at, dateadd(hour,48,t.ca))
  group by t.eid
),
b2 as (
  select base.*,
    iff(stv, cd='RESOLVED', rb in ('CSP','TECHNICIAN') and done_at is not null) closed_ok,     -- closed as resolved through the CSP
    dateadd(hour,48,ca) w48
  from base
)
select to_date(ca) d, iff(stv,'STV','NON_STV') cohort,
  count(*) tickets, count(distinct csp_id) csps,
  count_if(seen_at <= w48) seen48,
  count_if(av_at <= w48) sent_verif48,
  count_if(stv and closed_ok and done_at <= w48 and coalesce(rnd,0)=0 and not reop) pass_first48,
  count_if(reop) reopened,
  count_if(closed_ok and done_at <= w48) closed_ok48,
  count_if(cd='TIME_OVER') time_over,
  count_if(done_at is not null and not closed_ok) closed_by_others,
  count_if(closed_ok and done_at <= w48 and help_calls=0) unaided48,
  count_if(help_calls>0) helped,
  count_if(help_calls>0 and closed_ok and done_at > first_help_at) helped_then_closed,
  count_if(cur_state='AWAITING_VERIFICATION') waiting_verif_now,
  count_if(done_at is null) open_now,
  median(iff(stv and closed_ok and av_at is not null and done_at >= av_at, datediff(minute, av_at, done_at), null)) med_min_verif
from b2 group by 1,2 order by 1,2

meta.label: 03_step_reach_helpline.sql

-- Per step, cohort (STV / old flow) and day: CSPs reaching the step and their ticket/app helpline calls within 24 h.
-- cohort STV     = tickets on the Service Ticket Verification release (TAS stv_mode = true, live since 6 Nov 2026)
-- cohort NON_STV = same-day tickets on the old flow (baseline)
-- Steps (48 h window from creation):
--   received -> seen by CSP -> CSP marks resolved = sent for verification (state AWAITING_VERIFICATION)
--   -> closed as resolved (stv_closure_display = RESOLVED). FAIL = reopened back to CSP.
-- Helpline = CSP inbound call (PARTNER_CALL_LOG, created_at is IST) whose Kapture ticket L2 is TICKETS or CSP APP,
--            by the same CSP between ticket creation and close (or +48 h).
with cur as (

b2 as (

, steps as (

meta.label: 09_booking_releases.sql
meta.value:
-- Booking releases on the CSP app: GROW-17 bubble / new booking flow, GROW-96 guided decision flow, GROW-160 consent sheet.
-- One row per booking that reached a CSP = one install execution candidate (TAS), dated by when it reached the CSP (IST).
-- Cohorts come from TAS INSTALL_CSP_ACCEPTANCE_ROLLOUT history (when each CSP got enabled / guided_decision_enabled)
-- and, for the consent sheet, from the CSP app event sheet_opened{sheet=accept_consent}.
-- Output long format: release_id, cohort, d, metric, num, den.
with ro as (
  select csp_id,
    min(iff(enabled, convert_timezone('Asia/Kolkata', _fivetran_start)::timestamp_ntz, null)) enabled_from,
    min(iff(guided_decision_enabled, convert_timezone('Asia/Kolkata', _fivetran_start)::timestamp_ntz, null)) guided_from
  from PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_CSP_ACCEPTANCE_ROLLOUT group by 1
),
prof as (select distinct clevertap_id, lower(cspid) csp_id from PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CSP_API.PROFILE_DATA where cspid is not null),
ev as (
  select e.event_name, try_parse_json(e.properties):execution_id::string eid, try_parse_json(e.properties):sheet::string sheet,
         try_to_timestamp(e.timestamp) ts, p.csp_id
  from PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CSP_API.EVENTS_DATA e left join prof p on p.clevertap_id = e.clevertap_id
  where e.timestamp >= '2026-10-01' and e.event_name in ('sheet_opened','sheet_dismissed','install_accepted')
),
consent_csp as (select csp_id, min(ts) consent_from from ev where event_name='sheet_opened' and sheet='accept_consent' and csp_id is not null group by 1),
hist as (
  select execution_candidate_id eid,
    min(iff(acceptance_received, convert_timezone('Asia/Kolkata', updated_at)::timestamp_ntz, null)) acc_at,
    min(iff(executor_id is not null, convert_timezone('Asia/Kolkata', updated_at)::timestamp_ntz, null)) tech_at,
    min(iff(current_state='DECLINED', convert_timezone('Asia/Kolkata', updated_at)::timestamp_ntz, null)) dec_at
  from PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES
  where created_at >= '2026-09-24 18:30:00 +0000' group by 1
),
b as (
  select c.execution_candidate_id eid, lower(c.csp_id) csp_id,
    convert_timezone('Asia/Kolkata', c.created_at)::timestamp_ntz ca, c.current_state st, c.terminal_outcome tout,
    convert_timezone('Asia/Kolkata', c.installation_completed_at)::timestamp_ntz inst_at,
    h.acc_at, h.tech_at, h.dec_at, ro.enabled_from, ro.guided_from, cc.consent_from
  from PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES c
  left join hist h on h.eid = c.execution_candidate_id
  left join ro on lower(ro.csp_id) = lower(c.csp_id)
  left join consent_csp cc on cc.csp_id = lower(c.csp_id)
  where c._fivetran_active and c.created_at >= '2026-09-24 18:30:00 +0000'
),
b2 as (
  select b.*, to_date(ca) d,
    (enabled_from is not null and ca >= enabled_from) is_rollout,
    (guided_from is not null and ca >= guided_from) is_guided,
    (consent_from is not null and ca >= dateadd(hour,-12,consent_from)) is_consent,
    iff(guided_from is not null and guided_from < '2026-11-09', 'wave_1', 'wave_2') guided_wave
  from b
),
-- each release: who is in the release, and who is the baseline, per booking
tagged as (
  select 'grow-17-bubble' release_id, iff(is_rollout and not is_guided, 'release', iff(not is_rollout, 'baseline', null)) cohort, * from b2
  union all
  select 'grow-96-guided', iff(is_guided, 'release', iff(is_rollout, 'baseline', null)), * from b2
  union all
  select 'grow-96-guided', guided_wave, * from b2 where is_guided
  union all
  select 'grow-160-consent', iff(is_consent, 'release', iff(is_guided, 'baseline', null)), * from b2
),
t as (select * from tagged where cohort is not null),
m as (
  select release_id, cohort, d, 'bk_decided_24h' metric, count_if(least(coalesce(acc_at,'2100-01-01'), coalesce(dec_at,'2100-01-01')) <= dateadd(hour,24,ca)) num, count(*) den from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 'bk_timeout', count_if(st='CANCELLED_BY_UPSTREAM' and acc_at is null), count(*) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 'bk_acc_1h', count_if(acc_at <= dateadd(hour,1,ca)), count(*) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 'bk_assign_1h', count_if(acc_at is not null and tech_at <= dateadd(hour,1,acc_at)), count_if(acc_at is not null) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 'bk_declined', count_if(dec_at is not null), count(*) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 'bk_accepted', count_if(acc_at is not null), count(*) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 'bk_tech_24h', count_if(tech_at <= dateadd(hour,24,ca)), count(*) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 'bk_acc_no_tech_24h', count_if(acc_at <= dateadd(hour,24,ca) and (tech_at is null or tech_at > dateadd(hour,24,ca))), count_if(acc_at <= dateadd(hour,24,ca)) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 'bk_installed_14d', count_if(inst_at <= dateadd(day,14,ca)), count(*) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 'bk_install_after_accept', count_if(inst_at is not null), count_if(acc_at is not null) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 'bk_failed_after_accept', count_if(st='INSTALLATION_REPORTED_FAILED'), count_if(acc_at is not null) from t group by 1,2,3
),
-- consent sheet: opened -> confirmed (install accepted on the same booking after the open) or backed out
cs as (
  select o.eid, o.csp_id, to_date(o.ts) d, min(o.ts) opened_at,
    max(iff(a.event_name='install_accepted', 1, 0)) confirmed,
    max(iff(x.event_name='sheet_dismissed', 1, 0)) backed_out
  from ev o
  left join ev a on a.eid = o.eid and a.event_name='install_accepted' and a.ts >= o.ts
  left join ev x on x.eid = o.eid and x.event_name='sheet_dismissed' and x.sheet='accept_consent' and x.ts >= o.ts
  where o.event_name='sheet_opened' and o.sheet='accept_consent'
  group by 1,2,3
),
cov as (   -- consent PRD G1: no accept without consent, at consent CSPs after their first consent sheet
  select b2.d, count_if(exists (select 1 from ev o where o.eid = b2.eid and o.event_name='sheet_opened' and o.sheet='accept_consent' and o.ts <= dateadd(minute,5,b2.acc_at))) num, count(*) den
  from b2 where b2.is_consent and b2.acc_at is not null group by 1
),
mc as (
  select 'grow-160-consent' release_id, 'release' cohort, d, 'consent_confirmed' metric, sum(confirmed) num, count(*) den from cs group by 3
  union all select 'grow-160-consent', 'release', d, 'consent_backout', sum(backed_out), count(*) from cs group by 3
  union all select 'grow-160-consent', 'release', d, 'consent_coverage', num, den from cov
),
steps as (
  select release_id, cohort, d, 1 step_no, 'Booking reached CSP' step, count(*) users from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 2, 'Decided within 24 h', count_if(least(coalesce(acc_at,'2100-01-01'), coalesce(dec_at,'2100-01-01')) <= dateadd(hour,24,ca)) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 3, 'Accepted', count_if(acc_at is not null) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 4, 'Technician assigned', count_if(tech_at is not null) from t group by 1,2,3
  union all select release_id, cohort, d, 5, 'Installed', count_if(inst_at is not null) from t group by 1,2,3
)
select 'm' kind, release_id, cohort, d, metric, num, den, null step_no, null step from m where den > 0
union all select 'm', release_id, cohort, d, metric, num, den, null, null from mc where den > 0
union all select 's', release_id, cohort, d, null, users, null, step_no, step from steps where cohort in ('release','baseline')
order by 2, 4, 5, 3
